item.title: Bassett praises staff for 'the most successful' record-breaking year
item.description: Dennis BassettPhoto by Howard Owens Dennis Bassett praised the Western Regional Off-Track Betting Corporation's staff and leadership for what he called the most successful year in Batavia Downs' history at the end of the board's final meeting of 2025."The work that you have done, the effort that you have put in, accepting the change that was at the top, I think you should feel very good about where you are and what you have done," said Bassett, president of the Western OTB board of directors.

item.title: Batavia Downs board approves winter racing season with reduced schedule
item.description: File photo by Howard Owens The Western Regional Off-Track Betting Corporation board approved winter racing at Batavia Downs with a reduced schedule that leadership says addresses staff concerns about weather-related challenges.Racing will begin Jan. 13 with eight race days on Tuesdays and Thursdays at 3 p.m., down from 15 days last year.
